text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Rhein Kraft conquered the NHK Mile Cup. 
Her heart was filled with emotion having 
achieved the first-ever unconventional 
Double Crown.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
And she thanks Daring Heart, who told her 
that she looked up to her. The two share a 
warm handshake.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Later, Line Craft received a flower crown 
from her Trainer. Her Trainer explained 
they made it to celebrate her for 
following her own path.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
She feels truly happy with her very own 
tiara. She asked her Trainer to make her 
another tiara if she manages to seize 
glory further down the road.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
And Rhein Kraft announces she will forge 
her own path by pursuing the 
Unconventional Triple Crown. —Her next 
goal is the Shuka Sho.
